{{Quote|I won't deny that Kelrodo-Ai is proving a difficult target, but let's remember this: The Western Reaches Operation has restored security and the rule of law to eight sectors so far, with the successful liberation of 95 worlds.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shea Hublin]]|<ref name="TGoKA">{{InsiderCite|132|The Guns of Kelrodo-Ai (short story)}}</ref>}}
The '''Western Reaches Operation''' was a campaign launched by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] around [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], to [[Reconquest of the Rim|drive out]] the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|holdout]] forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] from the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]].

==Prelude==
During the final days of the Clone Wars, after the [[Battle of Bomis Koori IV|fall]] of [[Bomis Koori IV]], the remnants of the CIS forces fled [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] down the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] into the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]], seeking shelter amid the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] bases and [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]]' nests of the lawless region. After the rise of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] tasked [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] of [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] with pacifying the region.

Tarkin regarded the [[Planetary Security Forces]] in the Western Reaches to be unreliable, and considered the number of pirates and Separatist holdouts to be a significant threat. Consequently, he appealed for significant military resources. In response to Tarkin's request, [[Admiral/Legends|Admirals]] [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]] and [[Bannidge Holt]] were given joint command of the [[Western Reaches Superiority Force]], while [[General/Legends|General]] [[Hurst Romodi/Legends|Hurst Romodi]] was assigned to lead the ground forces and Tarkin commanded from Eriadu.<ref name="TEGtW" />

==The campaign==
[[File:Hurst_Romodi.jpg|thumb|left|200px|General Romodi leading from the open hatch of a [[HAVr A9 Floating Fortress/Legends|Floating Fortress]].]]
Advancing from [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]], Screed and Holt's forces defeated the Separatists early at the [[Battle of Kelrodo-Ai]] after the TIE Fighter ace [[Shea Hublin]] made a daring run against the [[Citadel of Axes]], bringing down the [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] in preparation for Romodi's ground assault. The Empire won a further victory at the [[Battle of Pendaxa]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

With the Rimward front secured, Tarkin turned his attention north. Imperial forces moved up the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] and defeated the Separatists at the [[Battle of Ord Vaug]], before swinging back south down the Corellian Trade Spine and winning victories at [[Battle of Halm|Halm]], [[Battle of Ichtor|Ichtor]], [[Battle of Little Petrovi|Little Petrovi]], and [[Battle of the Feather Nebula|the Feather Nebula]], where Hublin won further accolades. During these battles, Hurst Romodi became famous for directing assaults from the open top hatch of a [[HAVr A9 Floating Fortress/Legends|Floating Fortress]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

The campaign resumed in the south at [[Bryndar]]. There, Bannidge Holt was killed and Romodi badly injured in an [[Ambush at Bryndar|ambush]] by [[Iska pirates/Legends|Iska pirates]] disguised as local officials. Despite being blinded, Romodi continued to direct the ground operations of the campaign from a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

Screed and Hublin smashed the Iska pirates at the [[Battle of Fanha/Legends|Battle of Fanha]], forcing the pirate lord [[Guun Cutlax]] to flee into the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]]. Cutlax linked up with Separatist forces under the command of General [[Kendu Ultho]], but he was pursued by Screed and Hublin back up the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. Cutlax was defeated at the [[Battle of Tosste/Legends|Battle of Tosste]], and the campaign was concluded with the defeat of Ultho at the [[Battle of Ogoth Tiir/Legends|Battle of Ogoth Tiir]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

During the course of the operation, the Empire liberated ninety-five [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] and restored order to eight [[Sector/Legends|sectors]].<ref name="TGoKA" />

==Aftermath==
The Western Reaches Operation captured the imagination of the Imperial citizenry, with the battles at [[Ord Vaug system/Legends|Ord Vaug]], [[Halm]], [[Pendaxa]] and [[Ichtor system/Legends|Ichtor]] becoming famous throughout the Empire. In later years, Imperial citizens were said to always remember where they had been when they heard of Holt's death and Romodi's injury at [[Bryndar]]. The campaign was heavily propagandised by the Empire, and [[Holodrama/Legends|dramatised]] in films like ''[[The Charge at Feather Nebula]]'' and ''[[The Guns of Kelrodo-Ai]]''.<ref name="TEGtW" />

In the aftermath of the campaign, Hurst Romodi became the representative of his native [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]] in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], though psychological issues brought about by his injuries led him to serve only one term. His last command would be as [[Battle Station Operations Chief]] aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|First Death Star]] under his old commander, Tarkin. The operation was also the peak of [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed's]] career: he sank into obscurity after the operation and ended up leading corrupt business and slaving schemes in the Outer Rim with [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong]] of [[Roon/Legends|Roon]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
